stories.title: OpenAI protein-design study separates generation from lab validation
stories.alt: Conceptual workflow showing reasoning and code generating protein candidates, specialized models filtering candidates, and laboratory binding tests as a separate validation step.
stories.facts: OpenAI reports protein structure and sequence design with GPT-6 models using reasoning and code. Laboratory work with Onava found evidence of binding across five targets; specialist models helped filter candidates and supply sequences in the testing workflow.
stories.inference: Evaluate a general model’s proposed solution separately from specialist screening and independent validation; apply the same separation to financial research agents.
stories.uncertainty: Early research, not proof of an end-to-end specialist-free design process. Complete structure prediction remains a weakness, and binding is not clinical efficacy.

stories.title: New PPO hedging paper tests transfer from simulation to SPX options
stories.alt: Conceptual study panel showing stochastic-volatility simulation training, hedging with the underlying and another option, and historical SPX evaluation with a mid-price caveat.
stories.facts: The preprint trains PPO to hedge price and volatility risk using an underlying and a longer-dated option. It evaluates transfer to historical SPX options, reporting improved hedging outcomes concentrated in high-volatility episodes.
stories.inference: Test a two-instrument hedging environment against practitioner Delta and Delta-Vega baselines, with identical costs and independent risk limits.
stories.uncertainty: Unreplicated research. Historical tests use 2019–2022 data, quoted mid-price P&L and overlapping episodes; reported gains do not establish executable live performance or rehabilitate a rejected equity-allocation PPO strategy.

stories.title: Nasdaq futures fall more than 2% before the inflation release
stories.alt: Common-zero bar chart of November 25 futures changes at 5:01 a.m. CST: Dow E-mini minus 0.76%, S&P 500 E-mini minus 1.44%, and Nasdaq-100 E-mini minus 2.38%; not live ETF returns.
stories.facts: Reuters reported Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 E-mini futures down 0.76%, 1.44% and 2.38%, respectively, at 6:01 a.m. Eastern ahead of the inflation release.
stories.inference: Treat the QQQ-sensitive premarket gap and the scheduled data release as separate execution-risk windows; require fresh quotes before sizing participation.
stories.uncertainty: Reported snapshot, not executable live prices, SPY/QQQ returns or a prediction of the cash close.

stories.title: GDP and October PCE arrive together at 7:30 a.m. CST
stories.date: Scheduled November 25, 2026, 7:30 a.m. CST; results unknown at cutoff
stories.alt: Calendar panel for November 25 showing GDP second estimate and October PCE scheduled at 7:30 a.m. CST, followed by the cash opening auction at 8:30 a.m. CST. Results are unknown at cutoff.
stories.facts: BEA schedules third-quarter GDP’s second estimate and October Personal Income and Outlays for November 25 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern, equivalent to 7:30 a.m. Central.
stories.inference: Freeze pre-release inputs and measure the data reaction separately from the opening auction; avoid training on revised GDP as if it were known earlier.
stories.uncertainty: A scheduled release, not published results or a forecast. Subsequent revisions and policy interpretation remain uncertain.

stories.title: Dell lifts its full-year outlook after record quarterly revenue
stories.credit: Dell fiscal Q3 2027 earnings release, Nov. 24
nodes:
AI order backlog
Not realized revenue
stories.alt: Conceptual earnings panel distinguishing Dell’s completed quarter, its raised full-year revenue guidance, and AI backlog that has not yet become revenue.
stories.facts: Dell reported fiscal third-quarter revenue of 54.9 billion and raised fiscal 2027 revenue guidance from 192.0 billion to 202.0 billion, in U.S. dollars. It also reported a record AI backlog.
stories.inference: Separate booked demand, shipments and cash conversion in AI-infrastructure analysis; strong guidance alone does not establish investment returns.
stories.uncertainty: Company-reported unaudited results and forward guidance. Backlog conversion depends on customer financing and deployment capacity; no stock-price reaction is inferred.
